items.problem: The manifest migration guidance cannot be retrieved through the documented fetch tool: `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest` (and the slug the agent guessed from SKILL.md) both fail because the Manifest migration checklist section has no explicit <a id> anchor.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 16-18 (lines 1914-1943): `-Anchor "manifest-migration-checklist"` and `-Anchor "manifest"` both Write-Error 'Anchor not found'; agent then abandons the helper and grep's '## ' headings.
items.skill_search: grep '<a id=' MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md (18 anchors: threading, dialogs, windowing, csproj, xaml, ...) — no 'manifest'; grep 'manifest' SKILL.md line 158 links to #manifest-migration-checklist-windowsdesktop--runfulltrust
items.wrong_text_if_any: SKILL.md L158: '[Manifest migration checklist](./MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#manifest-migration-checklist-windowsdesktop--runfulltrust)' — a markdown slug Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 cannot resolve; the section carries no <a id> anchor.
items.root_cause: Anchor-fetch tool keys off explicit <a id> anchors, but the manifest section was never given one, and SKILL.md advertises a non-resolvable slug link. The manifest is the one artifact every UWP app carries, so the highest-stakes checklist (background-task extension removal that prevents 0x80080204 launch failure) is the least reachable via the intended mechanism.
items.proposed_fix: Add `` immediately above '### Manifest migration checklist' in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, and change the SKILL.md link to `#manifest` (and note the fetch command `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest`).
items.generalizes: Every UWP→WinUI 3 migration must reconcile Package.appxmanifest (TargetDeviceFamily, rescap/runFullTrust, background-task extensions). Any scenario whose manifest carries a windows.backgroundTasks extension fails to launch (0x80080204) and scores 0 if the agent can't reach this checklist — a recurring, high-impact discoverability gap independent of this sample.
